WITH launch AS (
                SELECT COALESCE(MAX(seq), 0) AS seq
                FROM events
                WHERE session_id = $1
                  AND kind = 'state_change'
                  AND payload->>'to' = 'running'
            )
            SELECT
                launch.seq AS "launch_seq!",
                COALESCE(
                    (
                        SELECT MAX((payload->>'_offset')::bigint)
                        FROM events
                        WHERE session_id = $1 AND seq < launch.seq
                    ),
                    0
                ) AS "start_offset!"
            FROM launch
